ratings.scale: Subjective holistic scores for observed emulated mobile interaction: 0 unusable, 5 playable with substantial friction, 7 good with clear friction, 9 excellent with minor friction, 10 exceptional. Wins and HUD scores are not quality grades. Overall is a judgment, not a numerical average.

reasons.overallMobile: Coherent, completable mission with helpful touch assistance and atmospheric presentation; repeated manual patrol tracking failures materially limit confidence in mobile combat.
reasons.controls: Large labeled controls, touch aim, scene swipe and reload all acted visibly. Simultaneous MOVE/FIRE drag repeatedly lost target and opening bursts reported COVER/NO IMPACT; this is observed friction, not a proven implementation defect. Continuous rearming is unassessed.
reasons.gameplay: Recovery-to-coils-to-upload provides clear progression. Coil vulnerability and OFF feedback were satisfying to understand. Mostly assisted travel and brief combat do not establish sustained challenge or enjoyment.
reasons.presentation: Consistent teal/amber visual language, rain, lit station and restrained terminal panel communicate atmosphere; software rendering limits visual fidelity judgment.
reasons.usability: Objective labels, route/approach affordances, progress slots, threat direction and upload instruction helped completion. Reload required an extra tray step; map overview was understandable but small.
reasons.readability: Health/ammo and key objective text clear; smaller signs, compact map, dark enemies and multiple overlapping HUD regions made tracking harder.

unassessed: Continuous enjoyment and continuous held-burst rearming
Recovered-memory prose; no enjoyment inferred for unread content

method.readScope: Only tools/mobile-playtest.mjs --help; no game source/tests/docs/prior reviews/recordings/internal state/target metadata inspected. Own screenshots and permitted visible UI only.
method.screenshots: Every screenshot viewed in a separate image-view call before dependent adaptive input. One new scene target coordinate per batch; after turn/scene tap, fresh view before next target.
method.boundaries: Inspected timings and observationBoundary; waits never exceeded 3000ms requested and frequently shortened to roughly 2.98s; FIRE waits <=1200ms requested, including shortened 1198ms and 1086ms. No bypass.
method.captureLifecycle: Each capture releases native contacts and may pause live mission; screenshots show live pre-pause view. Pausing clears AIM and closes TOOLS; reload selected by opening TOOLS and its action within one batch. This frequent observation limits realism, not evidence of a human reaction-time or causal quality benefit.
